abstract: BACKGROUND: Squamous cell carcinoma arising from malignant degeneration of a mature cystic teratoma is rare with a reported incidence of approximately 1-3%. The most common presenting symptoms are lower abdominal pain and increasing abdominal girth of several months' duration. Approximately 50% of the patients present with FIGO stage I while 35-38% present with stage III diseases. CASE: The case described herein represents an unusual presentation and initial diagnostic dilemma of locally aggressive squamous cell carcinoma arising in an ovarian dermoid cyst, with invasion into the distal rectum and anal canal causing rectal bleeding similar to the presentation of anal squamous cell carcinoma. Despite aggressive surgical management with posterior exenteration and optimal tumor debulking followed by 5040-cGy pelvic radiation utilizing 25-MV photons, the patient developed pelvic recurrence at the vaginal cuff 6 weeks after completion of her adjuvant radiotherapy. She subsequently failed cis-platinum single-agent chemotherapy and died 9 months after her initial surgery and diagnosis. CONCLUSION: Squamous cell carcinoma in the anal canal, diagnosed by colonoscopy or proctoscopy, could be an unusual presentation of that arising from malignant degeneration of an ovarian dermoid cyst. This tumor may behave in a locally aggressive manner and be resistant to pelvic radiation or single-agent chemotherapy of cis-platinum. The current experience of adjuvant treatment after comprehensive staging and cytoreductive surgery reported in the world literature is limited, and the optimal management of the malignancy remains unclear.
abstract_ja: 背景：成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の悪性変性に由来する扁平上皮癌は稀で、報告頻度は約1〜3%である。最も多い初発症状は、数か月続く下腹部痛と腹囲増大である。患者の約50%はFIGO病期Iで発見され、35〜38%はFIGO病期IIIである。症例：本症例は、卵巣類皮嚢腫に生じた局所浸潤性の扁平上皮癌が遠位直腸および肛門管へ浸潤し、直腸出血を呈して肛門扁平上皮癌に類似した非典型的な提示であり、初期診断に苦慮した。積極的な外科的管理として後方骨盤内臓器全摘術と最適腫瘍減量術を施行し、その後5040cGyの骨盤内放射線療法（25MV光子）を行ったが、補助放射線療法終了6週後に膣断端に骨盤内再発が生じた。その後シスプラチン単剤化学療法に抵抗性を示し、初回手術および診断から9か月後に死亡した。結論：肛門管の扁平上皮癌は大腸内視鏡または直腸鏡で診断されうるが、卵巣類皮嚢腫の悪性変性に由来する場合の非典型的な提示であり得る。本腫瘍は局所浸潤性に振る舞い、骨盤内放射線療法またはシスプラチン単剤化学療法に抵抗性を示すことがある。包括的な病期分類と減量手術後の補助療法に関する世界の文献上の経験は限られており、本悪性腫瘍の最適な管理は依然として不明である。
